reviewerFindings.claimDigest: Verification does not require pricing assertions on the optional Codex repair and generic-agentic structured-advisor model-threading paths, so cost can be silently undercounted.
The package-size chat-only fallback contradicts the fixed four-mode generator predicate, so that branch cannot both follow the fallback and pass the mandated transformation/provenance checks.
The provider-native structured-advisor consumeCodexAdvisorTurn call site is not covered by a completed-usage test, so an omitted optional model leaves native advisor usage unpriced.
Step 3 adds a second string model to runChatTurnWithRetry, but callArgs already requires model: LanguageModel; the planned field change is impossible.
Conditional published pricing (GPT-5.6 Sol above 272K tokens) is undefined; flat base-rate tests pass while long-context turns are materially underpriced.
The unrestricted last-segment slug fallback lets unlisted slash-prefixed models (e.g. local/gpt-5.5) inherit a listed model's price, violating the never-invent-dollars contract.
The plan forbids editing run-metrics.ts, so card-derived costs keep the false 'configured rates' provenance in the generated retrospective.
